headline: August CPI Drives Rate Hike Expectations; Taiwan Stocks Watch the 47,000 Level - Liberty Times Finance
summary: Taiwan equity advisers say the 47,000 level and whether volume recovers are key for the market. Rate hike expectations have risen following the August consumer price index data.
why: Taiwan's stock market is dominated by semiconductor and technology companies, and inflation data shapes expectations for central bank rates that affect valuations.
